message.gamemode.turned_off: Client game modes are turned off
gamemode.message.server_changed: The server changed your game mode to %s, so the client game mode ended
gamemode.command.server: No client game mode; using the server's game mode, %s
gamemode.command.status.client: Client game mode: %s. Server game mode: %s

gamemode.command.not_in_world: You need to be in a world to change the client game mode
options.gamemode.title: gamemode Settings
options.gamemode.enabled.tooltip: Whether /gamemode <mode> @c and the client game mode switcher may change your game mode on the client now. The Toggle gamemode key switches the same setting. Turning it off ends the client game mode. It has no effect on servers the multiplayer mode rules out.
options.gamemode.follow_server_changes.t: When the server changes your game mode, the client game mode ends and you use the server's new game mode. When off, the client game mode stays. Respawning or changing dimension in the same game mode never ends it.
options.gamemode.singleplayer_default.to: Whether a reset turns the mod on or off in singleplayer worlds.
options.gamemode.multiplayer_default.too: Whether a reset turns the mod on or off on servers the multiplayer mode allows.
options.gamemode.reset_on_world_exit.too: Every world starts with the mod in its default state instead of keeping the last state.
options.gamemode.reset_on_game_exit.tool: After restarting the game, the first world where the mod is allowed starts with the mod in its default state.
options.gamemode.multiplayer_mode.disabl: Never allows client game modes on multiplayer servers.
options.gamemode.multiplayer_mode.whitel: Allows client game modes only on servers in the server list.
options.gamemode.multiplayer_mode.blackl: Allows client game modes on all servers except those in the server list.
options.gamemode.edit_servers.tooltip: Edit the addresses used by the whitelist and blacklist modes.
options.gamemode.servers.title: Server List
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.gamemode: Changes your game mode on the client without asking the server. The server keeps your real game mode.
